cards.text: Up on a mountain, Jesus took three of His disciples, Peter, John and James, to pray, and as He prayed His face changed and His clothes became radiantly white (Luke 9:28-29). The next day they come down, and a large crowd meets Jesus at the bottom. You know that feeling when you take ONE day off and come back to 300 unread emails?
Suddenly a man in the crowd cries out, begging Jesus to look at his son, his only child. Friend, I'd yell over ANY crowd for any one of my six cookie cutter kids.

cards.question: What's wrong with the man's only son?

answers.text: A fever will not leave him
He has been blind from birth

cards.text: The father lays it all out: when the spirit seizes his son, the boy screams, goes into convulsions and foams at the mouth. It keeps mauling him and rarely leaves, and I think this dad is worn out.

cards.question: The father says he begged ___ to drive the spirit out of his son.

cards.text: The disciples gave it their best shot, and that spirit did NOT budge. Jesus replies, “O unbelieving and perverse generation!”

cards.question: Jesus asks, “How long must I remain with you and put up with you?” Then what does He tell the father?

answers.text: Go home and he will be well
Wait for Me in the town

cards.text: Even while the boy is on his way over, the demon slams him to the ground in a convulsion. I think that's hard for his dad to watch.

cards.question: The demon slams the boy to the ground while he's still on his way to Jesus. What does Jesus do?

answers.text: Rebukes the spirit and heals the boy
Tells His disciples to try again
Sends the boy to see the priest

cards.question: Once the boy is healed, Jesus gives him back to his father.

cards.text: Everyone is astonished at the greatness of God, and while the whole crowd is still going WOW, Jesus turns to His disciples. He tells them, “Let these words sink into your ears: The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men.”

cards.question: The disciples understand right away what Jesus means about the Son of Man being delivered into the hands of men.

cards.text: It's veiled from them so they can't comprehend it, and they're afraid to ask Him about it. I get it, friend. Sometimes a question feels scarier than not knowing.

cards.question: Then an argument starts among the disciples. What's it about?

answers.text: Which of them would be the greatest
Which of them should carry the money
Which town they should go to next

cards.text: But Jesus knows the thoughts of their hearts. Friend, I shared a junk drawer with dead batteries that argued over who had the most charge left, so trust me, I've heard THIS argument before.

cards.question: While the disciples argue about who's the greatest, who does Jesus have stand beside Him?
Jesus says whoever welcomes this little child in His name is welcoming ___.

cards.text: And Jesus keeps going: whoever welcomes Him welcomes the One who sent Him. Then He speaks right to that argument, and I bet some grown men suddenly find their sandals VERY interesting.

cards.question: Jesus tells the arguing disciples that whoever is the least among them is the greatest.

cards.text: Then John, one of Jesus' disciples, speaks up. “Master,” he says, and he tells Jesus about a man they saw doing something in Jesus' name.

cards.question: John tells Jesus they saw a man doing something in Jesus' name. What was the man doing?
John says they tried to stop the man driving out demons in Jesus' name. Why?

answers.text: He was not traveling with them
He was one of the Pharisees

cards.question: “Do not stop him,” Jesus replies. His reason: whoever is not ___ you is for you.
